name: @w6w-apps/youform
description: Read Youform forms and submissions, manage submission webhooks and enable submission refill links.

w6w.longDescription:
Youform is a form and survey builder with a deliberately small developer API, and this app covers all of it: the account profile, the list of forms, a single form's definition, the submissions collected by a form, the webhooks that push submissions to another system, and the refill link that lets a respondent reopen a submission.

It can list completed and partial submissions with sorting and page size, read a form's block definition so submission answers (keyed by block id) can be mapped back to question titles, register a webhook for a form and remove it again, and switch a submission's refill link on or off.

Good for pulling new form answers into a CRM or sheet on a schedule, wiring a form to a workflow through a webhook subscription, following up on abandoned partial submissions, and sending a respondent their refill link to correct an answer. Youform's API cannot create or edit forms, so this app does not either.
